title: Interactive SVG Animation
description: Change an SVG circle from blue to red when the button is clicked using JavaScript DOM access.
code:
<svg width="100" height="100">
  <circle id="myCircle" cx="50" cy="50" r="40" fill="blue" />
</svg>
<button onclick="changeColor()">Change Color</button>

<script>
function changeColor() {
  document.getElementById("myCircle").setAttribute("fill", "red");
}
</script>
output: An SVG blue circle appears. Clicking Change Color changes it to red.

title: Client-Side Game with Canvas (Moving Ball)
description: Draw and animate a moving square on an HTML5 Canvas using requestAnimationFrame.
code:
<canvas id="box" width="200" height="100" style="background:#ddd"></canvas>

<script>
const c = document.getElementById("box").getContext("2d");
let x = 10;

function move() {
  c.clearRect(0, 0, 200, 100);
  c.fillRect(x, 40, 20, 20); // Draw square
  x += 2;
  if (x < 180) requestAnimationFrame(move);
}
move();
</script>
output: A square moves from left to right across the canvas.

title: Interactive Form with Validation
description: Check that the name input is not empty before allowing form submission.
code:
<form onsubmit="return checkInput()">
  <input id="name" type="text" placeholder="Enter your name" />
  <button type="submit">Submit</button>
</form>

<script>
function checkInput() {
  const val = document.getElementById("name").value;
  if (val == "") {
    alert("Name cannot be empty!");
    return false;
  }
  alert("Submitted: " + val);
  return true;
}
</script>
output: An alert asks for a name if the field is empty; otherwise it displays the submitted name.
